From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>

Subject: MAP kickoff + target close cadence for MSA/DPA/Order form

Hi Samantha / MedArc team —

Thanks again for the time last week. Per our discussion, I pulled together a first-pass mutual action plan that aligns evaluation milestones with the procurement/legal sequencing so we avoid an order-form stall after all technical work is complete. Attached: MAP_v1.xlsx (timeline + owners).

High-level proposal (short):
- Week 1 (this week): Redwood provides MSA clean copy and baseline DPA checklist; MedArc provides SOC evidence & three pilot success criteria.
- Week 2–3: Parallel review — procurement pricing conversation + legal redlines.
- Week 4: Finalize Order Form (pricing locked) and target signature window for MSA + Order Form; DPA should be agreed in principle or have clear gating items.

Questions for you: do you have any immovable procurement windows in July? Also, do you need the DPA to be signed before MSA execution for data residency reasons, or are you comfortable with a parallel path where MSA and Order Form sign and DPA follows within a short SLA?

Next steps: If this sequencing looks reasonable I can convert the MAP into action items in the shared Drive and kick off a weekly 30-min alignment (internal-facing) to track redlines and evidence deliverables.

Thanks —
Markus Klein
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: MAP_v1.xlsx (timeline + owners)
From: Samantha Ruiz <samantha.ruiz@medarc.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@medarc.com, Kenji Ito <k.ito@medarc.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + target close cadence for MSA/DPA/Order form

Markus —

Thanks for the clear plan and the MAP draft. Quick answers:
- We have an internal procurement review week of Jul 5–9 that would be ideal for signature but can be flexible if legal needs more time.
- Data residency: Our security team prefers DPA signed before production data flows, but we can accept a signed MSA + Order Form with a DPA checklist agreed and a firm commitment (<=2 weeks) to sign the DPA post-MSA.

A couple of asks from our side before committing to the July window: can you confirm estimated token/usage pricing tiers (even ranges) for pilot vs production? Also need to confirm you can provide SOC2 type II evidence and a short runbook for logs/audit access.

If you can share the MSA clean copy and the DPA checklist today, I’ll route to legal and procurement.

Best,
Samantha Ruiz
Head of Procurement
MedArc Health
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2026 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + target close cadence for MSA/DPA/Order form

Samantha —

Appreciate the clarity. Uploaded the MSA clean copy and DPA checklist to the Drive link (see link below) and added estimated pricing ranges for pilot vs production in the MAP tab. Quick notes:
- Pricing: pilot (small scale) — $0.008–$0.012 per generated token depending on batching/latency profile; production (reserved) — committed throughput pricing starts at $xx,xxx/month for dedicated pools (we can detail once you confirm expected throughput).
- SOC2 type II: we can provide the attestation and our evidence package; I’ve added a short audit runbook (DPA_requirements.pdf).

Sequencing we recommend (to avoid re-work):
1) Redwood shares MSA clean copy + DPA checklist (done).
2) MedArc legal reviews DPA and flags gating items; procurement confirms target pricing bands.
3) Redwood receives redlines to MSA — legal to coordinate with Kar
4) Order Form (pricing) finalized in parallel — once pricing locked, the Order Form is prepared and both parties target MSA + Order Form signature.

We will track the DPA sign-off as a gating item for production data flows but are OK signing the MSA + Order Form earlier if a DPA SLA is agreed (<=2 weeks post MSA).

I’ve assigned internal owners in the MAP: laura will lead procurement pricing conversations; vanessa will own onboarding timeline and pilot success criteria; karthik will lead legal review.

Proposed next step: 30-min alignment call Thu Jun 24 10:00 AM PT to synchronize owners and confirm the Jul 5–9 target window. Are you available?

Thanks —
Markus

Thanks team — quick legal note from our side (high level):
- We’ll start with a redline to the MSA that keeps the core commercial terms intact but tightens liability carve-outs and clarifies data handling in Schedule 2.
- Regarding the DPA sequencing: MedArc’s preference to have DPA in place before production makes sense. To avoid blocking the July procurement window, recommend we: (a) get DPA checklist items agreed and documented in the MAP, (b) include a short transitional obligations clause in the MSA (limited and scoped) that allows pilot with non-production data or synthetic data until DPA is fully executed.
- If there are specific data residency clauses (e.g., EU-only), flag them now — that could change sequencing.

I attached a short MSA_redline_v1.docx stub with placeholders for the liability and data-handling language we plan to propose. Laura — once procurement confirms pricing lanes, please confirm the target Order Form fields so I can ensure the redline accommodates them.

-Karthik
Associate General Counsel, Redwood Inference
